transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Burning when I pass water.
When did you first notice the burning when you pass water?
About four days ago, I think.
Could you tell me about any allergies you have to medicines?
I'm allergic to trimethoprim. It gave me a rash.
How much is the burning bothering you from day to day?
My niece brought me today.
Could you tell me about any medicines you take regularly or have started recently?
I take a thyroid tablet every morning.
Can you tell me about any health problems you've had in the past that needed medical care?
I had a water infection last year.
Would you say the burning when you pass water is mild, moderate, or severe, or are you not sure?
The stinging is about five out of ten.
Have you noticed anything else different or bothering you along with the burning when you pass water?
The water looks cloudy.
Where do you feel the burning when you pass water, and does it move to any other place?
Just down below. It doesn't move anywhere else.
What, if anything, seems to make the burning worse?
I haven't noticed anything making it worse.
Is the burning there every time you pass water, or does it come and go?
Yes, every time I go.
What worries you most about the burning when you pass water?
I think it's another water infection.
Apart from the water infection you had last year, is there anything else about your past health you’d like to add?
I have an underactive thyroid.
Has the burning when you pass water changed anything about your usual daily activities?
I've stopped going to the coffee morning.
Apart from your urine looking cloudy, is there anything else you've noticed that you'd like to add?
It smells a bit stronger.
Apart from the water infection last year and your underactive thyroid, is there anything else about your past health you’d like to add?
I've got thin bones, they said.
Is there anything else you’d like to add?
My sister's girl, she brings me here.
Could you tell me about any medicines you're taking — regular ones, new or recently changed ones, or are you not sure — and if you know, what they are and how much you take?
I take a tablet for my thin bones, once a week.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
